title: Phota Labs uses AI to turn everyday photos into professional-looking shots
slides: Can Phota Labs fix your worst photos?
It uses AI to retouch everyday shots automatically
But it sometimes overcorrects faces and skin tones
You can test it free on ten photos today
Try one bad photo and judge the result yourself
thread_text:
1. Your Worst Photo, Fixed?

Phota Labs claims its AI can automatically retouch your everyday shots. If it works, you might never manually edit again.

2. How It Works

The AI analyzes faces and skin tones, then applies corrections. It's designed for quick, one-tap fixes.

3. The Overcorrection Problem

Sometimes it goes too far. Faces can look plastic and skin tones unnatural, so you'll need to double-check results.

4. Try It Free

You can test it on ten photos without paying. That's enough to see if the AI matches your taste.

5. One Photo Test

Take a bad photo and run it through the free trial. Does it fix the shot or create more work? Judge for yourself.

instagram.caption:
Ten photos, edited free, before you decide if it's worth it.

Phota Labs' AI retouches your everyday shots automatically: it reads faces and skin tones, then applies one-tap corrections. ⚡

Problem is, it sometimes overcorrects — faces go plastic, skin tones look off. So the result needs checking, not blind trust.

If you publish content, that's a real risk: one bad auto-fix can make a portrait look worse than the original.

Would you trust an AI with your worst photo, or do you still edit by hand? 📸
